terms.definition: A fraction written with a decimal point and place value instead of a numerator and denominator.
terms.whereItIs: The value shown by the grid and strip together.
terms.whyItMatters: Decimals are the standard format for money and measurement.

terms.definition: The dot that separates the whole-number part from the fraction part of a decimal.
terms.function: Everything right of it is a fraction of one whole.
terms.whereItIs: The dot on the place-value strip.
terms.whyItMatters: It marks where 'ones' ends and 'parts of one' begin.

terms.definition: The first three place values after the decimal point.
terms.function: 0.4 is 4 tenths; 0.75 is 75 hundredths; 0.006 is 6 thousandths.
terms.whereItIs: The labeled columns on the strip.
terms.whyItMatters: Reading decimals correctly means reading these places.

terms.definition: A 10-by-10 grid where each cube represents one hundredth.
terms.whereItIs: The square grid of 100 small cubes.
terms.whyItMatters: It makes decimals visual and concrete.
